I'll use a 100k pull-up on nUART/SPI to VIO to select SPI mode as per datasheet.

pin6: 1.99, -1.35

So:
Left side: 3 (top), 2 (mid), 1 (bottom)
Right side: 4 (top), 5 (mid), 6 (bottom)

Typically for these transformers:
IC side: pins 1 and 6? No, 1 and 3?
Wait, if I use pins 1 and 6 for one side, they are on opposite sides of the chip? No, 1 is bottom left, 6 is bottom right.
Actually, 1 and 6 are usually the primary. 3 and 4 are usually the secondary.

In BQ79600EVM:
COMHP -> C33 -> T1.1

Isolated side: Pins 6 and 5
